limitations: No LLM, generated repair, arbitrary customer configuration import or general customer binary adapter was tested or implemented by this kernel.
This is one trusted generated Linux HTTP proxy/cache profile, two synthetic labels, one resource and two fresh-cache request orders, not authentication or exhaustive isolation proof.
The deliberately incomplete key is a generated misconfiguration counterexample, not a new NGINX vulnerability or native code fix.
Cache disabling can be a separate mitigation policy; it fails this experiment because the declared contract also requires cache effectiveness.
Prior-art sources support the RFC comparisons, not an exhaustive literature search, novelty proof or absence of other stateful/cache tools.
Build consistency hashes are unsigned and do not establish supply-chain attestation, stable dynamic libraries or malicious same-UID isolation. Selected executables remain trusted local code.
Independent interruption fault injection was not repeated; the owner targeted TAP and preload control were inspected separately.
Procfs/file observations are sampled. The final accessible private-executable inventory was empty; inaccessible unrelated proc entries are excluded.
No native rebuild, full official aggregate, publication, production traffic or production configuration action was performed by this review.
